definitions.explanation: A decorative band or ring worn around the wrist or arm as jewelry or an accessory.

examples.japanese: {銀|ぎん}の{腕輪|うでわ}をしている。
examples.english: She is wearing a silver bracelet.

examples.japanese: {旅行|りょこう}{先|さき}で{手作|てづく}りの{腕輪|うでわ}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a handmade bracelet at my travel destination.

examples.japanese: {古代|こだい}の{遺跡|いせき}から{金|きん}の{腕輪|うでわ}が{出土|しゅつど}した。
examples.english: A gold bracelet was unearthed from ancient ruins.

notes:
USAGE:
{腕輪|うでわ} is the native Japanese word for bracelet. In modern everyday speech, ブレスレット (from English "bracelet") is more commonly used for fashion accessories, while {腕輪|うでわ} is preferred in historical, traditional, or formal contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {金|きん}の{腕輪|うでわ} (gold bracelet)
- {腕輪|うでわ}をはめる (to put on a bracelet)
- {腕輪|うでわ}を{外|はず}す (to take off a bracelet)

WORD FORMATION:
{腕|うで} (arm) + {輪|わ} (ring, circle). The {輪|わ} component appears in {指輪|ゆびわ} (ring [for fingers]).
